card.title: Operations Site Leader
card.description:
Railserve, US 
 
 As a part of the global industrial organization Marmon Holdings—which is backed by Berkshire Hathaway— you’ll be doing things that matter, leading at every level, and winning a better way. We’re committed to making a positive impact on the world, providing you with diverse learning and working opportunities, and fostering a culture where everyone’s empowered to be their best. 
 
 
Railserve is hiring an experienced and safety-focused Site Leader in Rosemount, MN to oversee daily rail switching and industrial rail operations. This is a full-time leadership position responsible for managing site operations, developing employees, maintaining strong customer relationships, and ensuring safe, efficient, and reliable service. 
 
 Who We Are 
 Railserve is a leading provider of industrial railyard services across the United States and Canada. Our teams deliver on-site rail switching, material handling and transloading, track construction and maintenance, and locomotive service and repair for customers who depend on safe, reliable rail operations every day. With decades of industry experience, Railserve is built on a foundation of safety, teamwork, and operational excellence. 

 We invest in our people, promote from within, and use innovative, safety-focused technology to keep railyards running efficiently. Learn more at Railserve.com.

 Job Description 
 The Site Leader is responsible for overseeing daily operations at an industrial rail facility, ensuring that rail switching, equipment maintenance, and related services are performed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with company standards and customer expectations.

 This position provides direct leadership to site employees, coordinates staffing and operational activities, manages equipment and resources, and serves as the primary point of contact for customer relationships and service requirements.

 The ideal candidate is dependable, safety-focused, organized, and comfortable leading employees in a fast-paced industrial environment. Strong communication, problem-solving, and leadership skills are essential for success in this role.

 This is an excellent opportunity for someone with supervisory experience in rail operations, logistics, manufacturing, or a similar industrial environment who is looking to further develop their leadership skills and operational 
 knowledge.

 Schedule 
 Site operates seven days per week on a rotating schedule
 Work schedule will be determined based on operational and staffing needs
 Flexibility to work varying shifts, weekends, and holidays as needed
 Additional hours may be required to support site operations
 
 Compensation 
 Starting salary: $85,000 annually 

 Duties 
 Safety & Training 
 Promote and maintain a safe working environment for all employees
 Ensure employees receive appropriate training on safety procedures, operating requirements, and company policies
 Monitor daily operations to ensure compliance with company, customer, and applicable regulatory requirements
 Maintain required safety certifications, training records, and operational documentation
 Identify potential safety hazards and implement corrective actions as needed
 Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, and continuous safety improvement
 
 Leadership & Employee Development 
 Oversee daily activities and performance of site employees
 Plan, assign, and coordinate work to ensure safe and efficient operations
 Develop employee work schedules to maintain appropriate staffing and skill coverage
 Provide coaching, training, and performance feedback to employees
 Identify high-performing employees and support their development into future leadership positions
 Participate in hiring, onboarding, employee evaluations, and performance management
 Address employee concerns and operational challenges in accordance with company policies
 
 Operational Management 
 Oversee rail switching, railcar movement, and other industrial rail services performed at the site
 Coordinate daily operations to meet customer production schedules and service requirements
 Monitor operational performance and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and service quality
 Manage site expenses, including payroll, fuel, equipment, and other operational costs
 Maintain accurate purchase orders and required operational records
 Coordinate preventive maintenance and equipment repairs with the mechanical department
 Ensure locomotives, rail equipment, and other operational resources are properly maintained and available for service
 Respond to operational issues and adjust staffing or resources as needed
 
 Customer Service 
 Build and maintain strong working relationships with customer representatives
 Serve as the primary point of contact for daily operational and service-related matters
 Communicate regularly with customers regarding service performance, operational needs, and potential concerns
 Ensure services are delivered safely, accurately, and in accordance with customer expectations and contract requirements
 Address customer concerns promptly and professionally
 
 Administrative Responsibilities 
 Oversee employee timekeeping, attendance, and scheduling
 Complete employee performance evaluations and required personnel documentation
 Prepare operational reports and maintain accurate site records
 Monitor labor costs, equipment expenses, and other operational expenditures
 Ensure required company and customer documentation is completed accurately and on time
 Communicate regularly with regional leadership regarding staffing, safety, equipment, and operational performance
 Perform additional duties as assigned
 
 Job Requirements 
 High school diploma or GED required
 At least one year of supervisory or leadership experience in rail operations, logistics, manufacturing, or a similar industrial environment
 Valid driver's license required
 Strong attendance and dependability required
 Ability to lead, train, and develop employees in an industrial environment
 Strong communication, customer service, and teamwork skills
 Ability to manage multiple tasks, priorities, and operational responsibilities effectively
 Strong organizational, problem-solving, and decision-making skills
 Ability to read and interpret safety rules, operating procedures, and technical instructions
 Ability to prepare reports, maintain records, and communicate effectively with employees and customers
 Basic computer skills and familiarity with administrative reporting and recordkeeping
 Ability to work outdoors in varying weather conditions
 Ability to walk on uneven terrain and navigate an active industrial rail yard
 Ability to perform physical activities associated with site inspections and operational oversight
 Strong attention to detail and situational awareness
 Ability to follow and enforce safety rules, operating procedures, and company policies
 Ability to participate in Railserve's pre-employment screening process
 Military experience is a plus
 
 What We Offer (Benefits) 
 Railserve is committed to being an Employer of Choice, offering competitive pay and a comprehensive benefits package:
 Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
 Company-paid employee and dependent life insurance
 Company-paid sickness and accident income
 401(k) with company match
 Annual safety shoe reimbursement
 Prescription safety wear
 Holiday pay
 Vacation
 Marmon employee discount program
 
 Additional Information 
 FRA-regulated industrial rail operation
 Leadership position requiring regular presence in an active industrial rail yard
 Exposure to locomotives, railcars, moving machinery, noise, dust, and varying weather conditions
 Combination of administrative responsibilities and hands-on operational oversight
 Frequent standing, walking, and navigating uneven surfaces
 Occasional climbing, bending, kneeling, and lifting
 Required use of personal protective equipment
 Safety-sensitive position requiring strict compliance with company, customer, and applicable regulatory safety procedures
 
 Grow With Us 
 Don't worry if you don't meet every qualification. Railserve values reliability, work ethic, leadership potential, and a willingness to learn. Our tools, technology, and processes continue to evolve, and we invest in training and developing our people for long-term success.

 Railserve provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals. We recruit, hire, train, promote, and compensate employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

 #LI-DNI
 
 
 
 
 Following receipt of a conditional offer of employment, candidates will be required to complete additional job-related screening processes as permitted or required by applicable law .
 
 
 We are an equal opportunity employer, and all applicants will be considered for employment without attention to their membership in any protected class. If you require any reasonable accommodation to complete your application or any part of the recruiting process, please email your request to careers@marmon.com, and please be sure to include the title and the location of the position for which you are applying.
